pullRequest.title: Show which acceptance criteria the issue already ticks
pullRequest.author: contributor-login
pullRequest.description:
Closes #231.

Reads whether each acceptance criterion is ticked in its issue's checklist, and marks a ticked criterion with a ✓ beside its quote in the overview.

Checked by hand in VS Code on a pull request whose linked issue ticks two of its four criteria: those two show a ✓ beside their quotes, and the other two show none.

A pass with a screen reader is still to do.
pullRequest.head: criteria-ticked

issues.title: Show which acceptance criteria are already ticked
issues.body:
An issue's author often ticks a criterion once it is done, and the overview shows every criterion the same way.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A criterion ticked in the issue's checklist is read as ticked.
- [ ] Both `[x]` and `[X]` count as ticked.
- [ ] The overview shows a ✓ beside the quote of a ticked criterion.
- [ ] A screen reader announces a ticked criterion as ticked.
- [ ] Reading the ticks adds no noticeable time to a review.
- [ ] The overview counts the ticked criteria beside its heading, such as `2 of 4 ticked`.
